instructions.9: Boil the pasta in salted boiling water for 10 minutes until half-cooked.
instructions.10: Add the pasta to the sauce and stir well.
instructions.11: Add some pasta water to adjust the consistency.
instructions.12: Add the crushed pepper and stir well.
instructions.13: Serve the dish hot.

fah-452.title: Chicken Pasta
fah-452.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-452.culturalNotes: Add more peas to taste. Serve with a green salad or fresh bread.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the pasta and brown until golden.
instructions.3: Add the washed, drained chicken pieces and brown until golden.
instructions.4: Add the minced onion and garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.5: Add the cumin, coriander, pepper, and salt; stir well.
instructions.6: Add the peas and pureed tomatoes and let the mixture simmer for 5 minutes.
instructions.7: Add the tomato sauce and instant stock, cover the pot, and let it boil.
instructions.8: After it boils, add the pasta, cover the pot, and let it boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Stir the pasta, cover the pot again, and leave for another 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Add hot pepper to taste and leave for 5 more minutes.
instructions.11: Serve the dish hot.

fah-453.title: Liver Pasta
fah-453.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-453.culturalNotes: Add more spices to taste. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Blend the red pepper, garlic, and tomatoes in the blender or food processor until smooth.
instructions.2: Heat a tray or pot over heat, add a spoonful of ghee and 3 tablespoons of oil. Once hot, add the tomato sauce and the blended tomatoes.
instructions.3: Add the salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, and instant stock. Cover and let the sauce simmer until thickened.
instructions.4: Add boiling water (about one bag's worth). Let the mixture boil, then add the desired amount of pasta.
instructions.5: Adjust the salt if needed, cover the pot, and let it boil. Once boiling, stir the pasta once, lower the heat, and let it cook through.
instructions.6: Slice the liver thinly. Crush 5 garlic cloves with a pinch of salt.
instructions.7: Heat a pan over heat and add 2–3 tablespoons of oil. Once hot, add the garlic and sauté until colored.
instructions.8: Add the liver pieces and stir until they change color. Add the green and hot peppers and stir well.
instructions.9: Season the liver with salt and pepper.
instructions.10: Add a pinch of sugar to the pasta sauce.
instructions.11: Once the pasta is cooked, add the liver to the sauce and stir well.
instructions.12: Serve the dish hot.

fah-454.title: One-Pot Pasta
fah-454.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-454.culturalNotes: Increase the sauce quantity to taste. Add more boiling water if the pasta needs more cooking time.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the onion, colored pepper, and chopped tomatoes and stir for a minute.
instructions.3: Add the stock cube, salt, black pepper, cumin, and coriander; stir well.
instructions.4: Add the boiling water, cover the pot, and let it simmer over low heat for 7–10 minutes.
instructions.5: Add the pasta and stir well, then let it boil for 3–5 minutes until cooked.
instructions.6: Remove the pot from the heat and serve hot.

fah-455.title: Shrimp Pasta in White Sauce
fah-455.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-455.culturalNotes: Add chopped green or red pepper for more flavor and color. Leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Boil water in a pot, add the salt, then add the pasta and leave until cooked.
instructions.2: In a pan, add the oil and butter and let them heat through.
instructions.3: Add the onion and garlic and stir until the onion is golden.
instructions.4: Add the black pepper, chili, and celery; stir well.
instructions.5: Add the fish stock and let it boil.
instructions.6: Add the shrimp and mushrooms and leave until cooked.
instructions.7: Add the cooking cream and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the boiled pasta and toss until coated in the sauce.
instructions.9: Add the chopped dill and stir well.
instructions.10: Serve the dish hot.

fah-456.title: White Sauce Pasta with Chicken Kofta
fah-456.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-456.culturalNotes: Canned mushrooms work if fresh aren't available. Serve with a side salad.

instructions.1: Boil the pasta until two-thirds done.
instructions.2: Mince the chicken breasts in the food processor and add the Knorr kofta mix.
instructions.3: Mix the chicken well with the mix and shape into equal balls.
instructions.4: Heat a pan over heat and add the oil and butter.
instructions.5: Brown the kofta until golden.
instructions.6: Add the minced onion and sauté until wilted and golden.
instructions.7: Add the sliced mushrooms and toss the mixture.
instructions.8: Add the Knorr stock cube, salt, and pepper.
instructions.9: Add half the milk and stir the mixture.
instructions.10: Add the other half of the milk with the Knorr béchamel mix and stir.
instructions.11: Add the kofta to the mixture and leave over medium heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.12: Add the pasta to the mixture and toss well.
instructions.13: Serve the dish garnished with parsley and tomatoes.

fah-457.title: Mini Cheese Sandwiches
fah-457.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-457.culturalNotes: Use different cheeses to taste. If you can't find date molasses, use regular molasses instead.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg, butter, warm milk, and water gradually; knead until the dough is cohesive and elastic.
instructions.3: Add a spoonful of oil and mix it in well.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for 7–10 minutes until smooth and cohesive.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rise until doubled.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into 20 small balls.
instructions.7: Cover the balls and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Stuff each ball with cheese and seal it well.
instructions.9: Dip each ball in the date molasses, then in toasted sesame.
instructions.10: Flatten them slightly and place on an oiled griddle or tray.
instructions.11: Bake at high heat until golden.
instructions.12: Let them cool, then cover with a clean towel.
instructions.13: Store in plastic bags in the freezer for longer keeping.

fah-458.title: Tender & Crispy Nuggets
fah-458.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-458.culturalNotes: Serve the nuggets with ketchup or mayonnaise. They keep in the freezer for up to a month.

instructions.1: Prepare the crispy coating and crush it lightly.
instructions.2: Put the chicken breasts in the food processor and mince into small pieces.
instructions.3: Add the paprika, black pepper, chili, onion powder, garlic powder, chicken spices, instant bouillon, salt, and starch. Mix the ingredients well.
instructions.4: Add the boiled, cooled potatoes and knead the mixture.
instructions.5: Prepare the egg, starch, salt, and black pepper mixture in a bowl.
instructions.6: Shape the nuggets into pieces of about 30 g each.
instructions.7: Coat the nuggets in flour, then in the egg mixture, then in the crispy coating.
instructions.8: Fry the nuggets in oil until golden.
instructions.9: Keep the nuggets in the freezer if you want to store them longer.
instructions.10: Bake the potatoes in the oven for 5 minutes at 180°C.
instructions.11: Bake the nuggets in the oven at 180°C for 15 minutes, then flip them and bake for another 15 minutes.

fah-459.title: Roasted Potatoes with Bramley Cheese Dip
fah-459.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-459.culturalNotes: This recipe also works for school lunchboxes.

instructions.1: Wash the potatoes well, cut them in half, then cut each half into three pieces.
instructions.2: Boil the potatoes in water with a pinch of salt for 7 minutes.
instructions.3: Lift the potatoes out of the water and place them in a tray greased with oil or lined with parchment.
instructions.4: Sprinkle a pinch of pepper, paprika, and thyme over the potatoes.
instructions.5: Bake the tray at the highest temperature until the potatoes are browned.
instructions.6: While the potatoes roast, mix the Bramley cheese with the yogurt, a spoonful of thyme, and the olive oil.
instructions.7: Serve the crispy potatoes with the delicious dip.

fah-001.title: 3 Types of Kofta: Breaded Kofta, Rice Kofta & Hati Kofta
fah-001.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-001.culturalNotes: You can freeze the kofta on foam plates with a plastic bag between layers to stop them sticking. Let them come to room temperature before cooking.

instructions.1: Making the breaded kofta:
instructions.2: Mix the minced meat with the cooked rice, minced onion, chopped parsley, salt, pepper, meat spices, and instant bouillon.
instructions.3: Knead the mixture well until it holds together.
instructions.4: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
instructions.5: Dip the kofta in flour, then in the egg-and-milk mixture, then in the breadcrumbs, flour, and starch mixture.
instructions.6: Fry the kofta in hot oil over medium heat until golden.
instructions.7: Making the rice kofta:
instructions.8: Mix the minced meat with the ground rice, minced onion, garlic, mixed herbs, salt, pepper, cumin, ground coriander, and sugar.
instructions.9: Knead the mixture well until it holds together.
instructions.10: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
instructions.11: Fry the kofta in hot oil over medium heat until golden.
instructions.12: Making the hati kofta:
instructions.13: Mix the minced meat with the washed and drained bulgur, minced onion, chopped parsley, salt, pepper, meat spices, and instant bouillon.
instructions.14: Knead the mixture well for about 10 minutes until it holds together.
instructions.15: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
instructions.16: Grill the kofta on a grill pan, over charcoal, or in the oven until golden.

fah-002.title: Chicken Wings in Hot Buffalo Sauce
fah-002.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-002.culturalNotes: Reduce or remove the chili if you don't like spicy food. You can also serve the wings with a side salad or French fries.

instructions.1: Wash the wings well and soak them in water and vinegar for 10 minutes, then drain.
instructions.2: Mix the flour and starch with the salt, pepper, and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.3: Pat the wings dry with a kitchen towel, then coat them well in the flour-and-starch mixture.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the wings until golden (about 15–20 minutes).
instructions.5: Drain the fried wings on a kitchen towel.
instructions.6: In another bowl, melt the butter, then add the tomato sauce, ketchup, molasses, soy sauce, sugar, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, black pepper, and chili (optional).
instructions.7: Stir the mixture over the heat until it thickens.
instructions.8: Add the fried wings to the sauce and toss until well coated.
instructions.9: Serve hot with side sauces of your choice.

fah-003.title: Steak with Mushroom Sauce
fah-003.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-003.culturalNotes: You can use a tenderloin cut instead of T-bone; it cooks faster.

instructions.1: Season the steak with salt and pepper on all sides.
instructions.2: Heat the butter in a pan over medium heat, add the steak slices, and sear until they take color on both sides.
instructions.3: After searing, cover the pieces with foil or a lid to keep them warm.
instructions.4: In the same pan, add the onion cut into small cubes and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.5: Add the garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the sliced mushrooms and stir until they shrink.
instructions.7: Add the salt and black pepper and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the flour and stir until well combined with the mushrooms.
instructions.9: Add the hot water and stir until the sauce thickens.
instructions.10: Add the cream and the bouillon and stir until the sauce is smooth.
instructions.11: Serve the steak with the mushroom sauce; it also goes well with grilled vegetables or white rice.

fah-004.title: Duck Stuffed with Freekeh
fah-004.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-004.culturalNotes: Serve the stuffed duck with a green salad or basmati rice. It keeps in the fridge for 2 days or can be frozen for a month.

instructions.1: Wash the duck and soak it in water, vinegar, and salt for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Rinse the duck and drain it.
instructions.3: Soak the freekeh in water for half an hour, then rinse and drain.
instructions.4: Cut the onion, tomatoes, carrot, and celery into small pieces.
instructions.5: In a pot, sauté the onion with the ghee, salt, pepper, and seven-spice.
instructions.6: Add the freekeh to the pot and stir it with the onion and spices.
instructions.7: Leave the mixture on the heat briefly until warmed through.
instructions.8: Let the mixture cool, then stuff the duck with it.
instructions.9: Close the duck opening with the liver and gizzards.
instructions.10: Prepare the marinade by mixing the ketchup with water and the spices.
instructions.11: Rub the duck with the marinade on the outside.
instructions.12: Place the duck in an oven bag with the vegetables and spices and seal the bag well.
instructions.13: Pierce the bag in 3–4 places and place it in a baking tray.
instructions.14: Put the tray in a preheated oven on high heat for half an hour.
instructions.15: Lower the oven temperature and leave the duck for 2–3 hours until cooked through.
instructions.16: Serve the duck with the freekeh cooked in the duck sauce.

fah-005.title: Traditional Tarab (Grilled Minced Meat in Caul Fat)
fah-005.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-005.culturalNotes: You can add onion and pepper while grilling for a lovely aroma. Tarab keeps in the fridge for 2 days or can be frozen for longer.

instructions.1: Prepare the minced meat: have the butcher grind the meat twice with 20% fat.
instructions.2: Prepare the onion: grate two large onions and squeeze them well.
instructions.3: Mix the ingredients: place the meat in a bowl and add the grated onion, salt, pepper, sugar, spices, and baking powder. Mix well until combined.
instructions.4: Prepare the caul fat: cut it into large squares.
instructions.5: Shape the tarab: take a portion of the meat mixture, shape it into a finger, and wrap the caul fat around it.
instructions.6: Prepare the skewers: thread the tarab onto skewers, making sure each piece is secure.
instructions.7: Grill: place the skewers on the rack over charcoal, leaving enough space to avoid burning. Turn the skewers regularly until the tarab takes a nice color and cooks through.
instructions.8: Serve: serve the tarab hot with parsley, grilled vegetables, and toasted bread.

fah-006.title: Turkish-Style Chicken
fah-006.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-006.culturalNotes: Add fresh herbs like parsley or fresh coriander for extra flavor. The chicken keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the onion and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the garlic, hot pepper, green pepper, and tomatoes, and stir for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Add the chicken bouillon, salt, black pepper, cinnamon, and dried coriander, and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the water and leave until it boils.
instructions.6: Add the chicken and let it cook for 40 minutes over low heat.
instructions.7: Add the raisins and green olives, and let it cook for another 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Serve the chicken hot with rice or bread.

fah-007.title: Browned Lung and Spleen (Fesha & Tehal)
fah-007.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-007.culturalNotes: Make sure the spleen and lungs are fresh, and wash them well before cooking. Serve with arugula and baladi bread for the best taste.

instructions.1: Wash the spleen and lungs and soak them in water for 10 minutes, then drain.
instructions.2: Place the spleen and lungs in a pot of boiling water, bring back to a boil, then drain.
instructions.3: Place the spleen and lungs in a clean pot, add boiling water, bay leaves, mastic, cardamom, salt, sugar, celery, carrot, tomato, and garlic, and let them cook until done.
instructions.4: Cut the spleen and lungs into slices.
instructions.5: In a pan, add the oil and stir the lungs for a minute, then add the garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the onion and stir for 3 minutes until softened.
instructions.7: Add the hot pepper and mixed peppers, and stir with the salt, dried coriander, black pepper, cumin, and spices.
instructions.8: Add the spleen to the pan and stir over the heat until browned, taking care of splattering oil.
instructions.9: Arrange the spleen and lungs over a bed of parsley.
instructions.10: Serve with arugula, baladi bread, and sandwiches.

fah-008.title: Saudi Kabsa with Daqqus Sauce
fah-008.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-008.culturalNotes: Daqqus keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days. Serve the kabsa with a green salad or yogurt.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over the heat, then add the chicken pieces and brown them well.
instructions.2: Add the finely chopped onion and stir until it takes a dark golden color.
instructions.3: Add the minced garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.4: Add the whole spices (salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, seven-spice, cloves, cardamom, black peppercorns, cinnamon, bay leaves).
instructions.5: Add the chicken pieces and toss with the spices, garlic, and onion.
instructions.6: Add the grated tomatoes, green pepper, and carrot, and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the water (2¼ cups) and bring to a boil.
instructions.8: Cover the pot and leave on low heat for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
instructions.9: Add the washed and drained basmati rice and stir well.
instructions.10: Cover the pot and leave on low heat until the rice is cooked.
instructions.11: In another bowl, add the chopped tomatoes, hot pepper, mint, minced garlic, coriander, chili, salt, black pepper, tomato sauce, vinegar, and water, and squeeze everything well together.
instructions.12: Transfer the daqqus to a bowl and set aside.
instructions.13: Add the lemon juice to the daqqus and stir well.
instructions.14: Serve the kabsa hot with the daqqus.

fah-009.title: El-Ghamrawi Kbeiba (Rice & Meat Balls in Broth)
fah-009.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-009.culturalNotes: Freeze the kbeiba after boiling on foam plates for later use; brown them in egg and milk or reheat when needed.

instructions.1: Mix the minced meat with the soaked, well-drained rice.
instructions.2: Add the parsley, dill, coriander, minced onion, garlic, salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, seven-spice, cinnamon, sugar, and instant bouillon.
instructions.3: Mix the ingredients well until combined.
instructions.4: Take a piece of the mixture and shape it into a kbeiba ball.
instructions.5: Arrange the kbeiba in a tray and coat them with oil.
instructions.6: Heat the oil in a pot and add onion slices, tomatoes, and peppers.
instructions.7: Add the kbeiba to the pot and cover them with boiling, salted broth.
instructions.8: Leave the pot on high heat for 10 minutes until it boils.
instructions.9: Lower the heat and let the kbeiba cook for an hour to an hour and a quarter.
instructions.10: After cooking, you can dip the kbeiba in egg and milk and fry them in oil.
instructions.11: Serve the kbeiba hot with fresh parsley.

fah-010.title: Cold Roast Beef
fah-010.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-010.culturalNotes: You can also serve the cold roast with seasoned rice. Leaving the roast in the fridge for a full day before serving gives the best flavor.

instructions.1: Prepare the roast with twine as Chef Fatma Abu Hati explained.
instructions.2: Wash the roast well and make slits in it with a thin knife.
instructions.3: Stuff the slits with the peppercorns, salt, whole peppers, ground pepper, tomatoes, onion, carrot, celery, thyme, and cardamom.
instructions.4: Season the outside of the roast with salt, ground pepper, thyme, and cardamom.
instructions.5: Leave the roast for half an hour to absorb the seasoning.
instructions.6: Heat a little oil in a tray on the stove and brown the roast on all sides until it takes a nice color.
instructions.7: Add the vegetables (onion, tomatoes, carrot, celery, bay leaves) to the tray.
instructions.8: Add two cups of boiling water, a teaspoon of sugar, and salt.
instructions.9: Cover the tray with aluminum foil and leave on low heat for an hour.
instructions.10: After an hour, turn the roast, cover again, and leave for another hour.
instructions.11: Let the roast cool, then refrigerate overnight.
instructions.12: The next day, slice the roast thinly.
instructions.13: For the vermicelli: cut the onion and colored peppers into small cubes.
instructions.14: Heat a little oil and ghee in a pot, add the vermicelli, and stir until golden.
instructions.15: Add the onion and colored peppers and stir with the vermicelli.
instructions.16: Add the water, salt, pepper, cinnamon, and the meat sauce, and leave until the vermicelli is cooked.
instructions.17: For the liver (optional): heat a little oil in a pot, add the liver, and stir until cooked.
instructions.18: Add the salt, pepper, and cinnamon and stir until done.
instructions.19: Serve the cold roast with the vermicelli and liver (if desired).

fah-011.title: Cold Meat Roast with Mixed Rice
fah-011.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-011.culturalNotes: Serve with nuts and sauce for a richer taste. The roast keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Trim the fat from the roast and tie it with cotton twine.
instructions.2: Season the roast with salt, pepper, and garlic.
instructions.3: Brown the roast in butter and oil on all sides.
instructions.4: Add the onion, celery, tomatoes, bay leaf, and hot water, and bring to a boil.
instructions.5: Turn the roast after an hour and let it cook for another hour.
instructions.6: Remove the roast and let it cool in the fridge for two to three hours.
instructions.7: Strain the sauce and blend part of it with the vegetables.
instructions.8: Return the sauce to the pan, add the flour, and stir until thickened.
instructions.9: Add the hot water, salt, pepper, and cinnamon, and bring to a boil.
instructions.10: Add the rice to the sauce, stir well, bring to a boil, then lower the heat and let it cook.
instructions.11: Add the raisins and let the rice finish cooking.
instructions.12: Sauté the liver in oil until its color changes and add the spices.
instructions.13: Remove the twine from the roast and cut it into slices.
instructions.14: Serve the cold roast with the rice, liver, and nuts.

fah-012.title: Sautéed Minced Meat (Easy & Delicious)
fah-012.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-012.culturalNotes: Prepare a large batch of seasoned minced meat before Ramadan and freeze it to save time and effort.

instructions.1: In a tray over the heat, put a spoonful of ghee and a little oil.
instructions.2: Add the minced onion and sauté until golden.
instructions.3: Add the minced meat and stir well with the onion until cooked.
instructions.4: Add a pinch of sugar, pepper, salt, cinnamon, and thyme, and stir well.
instructions.5: Leave the mixture until fully cooked.
instructions.6: Once cooked, let the meat cool completely.
instructions.7: Store the seasoned meat in freezer bags and use as needed.

fah-013.title: Palestinian Musakhan
fah-013.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-013.culturalNotes: Use taboon bread instead of baladi bread if available. You can add nuts for garnish and flavor.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken and clean it well inside and out.
instructions.2: Cut the chicken lengthwise and make slits with a knife so the marinade penetrates.
instructions.3: Cut the onions into wedges.
instructions.4: Add the olive oil, pomegranate molasses, sumac, black pepper, and salt to the onions and toss well.
instructions.5: Rub the chicken with the marinade and let it rest.
instructions.6: Place the chicken in a baking tray, add the tomato wedges and a little olive oil.
instructions.7: Cover the tray with parchment paper, then aluminum foil.
instructions.8: Bake at 220°C for two hours.
instructions.9: Once the chicken is out of the oven, arrange the baladi bread on the serving plate.
instructions.10: Pour the sauce of onions, olive oil, and sumac over the bread.
instructions.11: Garnish with pomegranate, coriander, lemon, and nuts as desired.
instructions.12: Serve hot.

fah-014.title: Lebanese Mansaf
fah-014.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-014.culturalNotes: The rice keeps in the fridge for 2 days. Serve with tahini salad or grilled eggplant.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot, add the mastic and meat, and stir until well browned.
instructions.2: Add the tomatoes, carrot, minced onion, bay leaf, and ground cardamom, and stir together.
instructions.3: Add boiling water to cover the meat and leave on low heat until cooked through.
instructions.4: Add the salt and sugar, let it boil, then lower the heat and let it finish cooking.
instructions.5: In another pot, heat the ghee and oil, add the minced onion, and stir until softened.
instructions.6: Add the minced meat, cinnamon, bay leaf, and black pepper, and stir until the meat is browned.
instructions.7: Add the minced garlic and mix well.
instructions.8: Wash the rice, soak it for half an hour, drain, and add it to the minced meat.
instructions.9: Add the boiling broth to the rice and stir until the rice absorbs the liquid.
instructions.10: Cover the pot and cook on high heat for 5 minutes, then lower the heat until the rice is done.
instructions.11: Prepare the yogurt salad: place the yogurt in a fine strainer to drain.
instructions.12: Finely chop the mint and add it to the yogurt with the lemon juice, black pepper, and salt.
instructions.13: Add the olive oil, nuts, and coriander, and stir well.
instructions.14: Serve the rice with the boiled meat, nuts, coriander, and the yogurt salad.

fah-015.title: Budget Chicken Pane (Fake Pane)
fah-015.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-015.culturalNotes: Freeze the pane after shaping and fry when needed. Great for gatherings and very tasty.

instructions.1: Mince the onion in the food processor.
instructions.2: Add the chicken spices, salt, cumin, black pepper, and paprika. Mix well.
instructions.3: Add half a kilo of chicken (breasts or thighs) and mince it well with the other ingredients.
instructions.4: Transfer the mixture to a deep plate.
instructions.5: Add a cup of ground breadcrumbs and the mashed potato. Knead well until the mixture is firm and easy to shape.
instructions.6: Prepare the coating: mix 2 cups of breadcrumbs, half a cup of starch, a pinch of salt, a pinch of black pepper, coriander, cumin, and paprika.
instructions.7: Take a piece of the mixture, roll it into a ball, then press it into the coating.
instructions.8: Repeat until the mixture is used up.
instructions.9: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the pieces until golden.
instructions.10: Serve the pane on a bed of parsley.

fah-016.title: Crispy Spleen Pane
fah-016.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-016.culturalNotes: Serve the spleen pane with pasta or as sandwiches. You can add red or white sauce for serving.

instructions.1: Put the water in a pot over the heat until it boils.
instructions.2: Add the carrot, tomato, onion, celery, garlic, mastic, cardamom, bay leaf, and cloves to the boiling water.
instructions.3: Let the ingredients boil for a few minutes until fragrant.
instructions.4: Wash the spleen well with water and vinegar and let it dry.
instructions.5: Place the spleen in the boiling water and poach on low heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Remove the spleen from the water and let it cool.
instructions.7: Cut the spleen into pieces about 1 cm thick.
instructions.8: In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and black pepper.
instructions.9: In another bowl, mix the flour, starch, salt, black pepper, and spices as desired.
instructions.10: Dip the spleen pieces in the egg-and-milk mixture, then in the flour-and-starch mixture.
instructions.11: Fry the spleen pieces in hot oil over medium heat until golden and crispy.
instructions.12: Remove from the oil and drain on absorbent paper.
instructions.13: Serve the spleen pane with pasta or as sandwiches.

fah-017.title: Homemade Roast Turkey
fah-017.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-017.culturalNotes: Serve the turkey with seasoned rice for a complete, delicious meal.

instructions.1: Prepare the brine by mixing the salt, orange, lemon, ginger, cinnamon, and red vinegar. Soak the turkey in this brine for 3–4 hours.
instructions.2: After soaking, prepare the marinade by mixing the salt, saffron, mahlab, seven-spice, cinnamon, onion powder, garlic powder, pepper, instant bouillon, ketchup, and red vinegar.
instructions.3: Wash the turkey and work the marinade into its flesh through small slits made with a knife.
instructions.4: Place the carrot, onion, and tomato inside the turkey cavity.
instructions.5: Place the turkey in an oven bag and seal it well, making two small vents.
instructions.6: Place the turkey in a large tray and add boiling water.
instructions.7: Roast on high heat for half an hour, then lower the heat and leave for 2–3 hours until cooked through.
instructions.8: Check the turkey is done by pressing on the wing before serving.

fah-018.title: Beef Scaloppine with Potatoes
fah-018.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-018.culturalNotes: Serve with pasta or basmati rice with peas.

instructions.1: Pound the scaloppine slices inside a plastic bag until thin.
instructions.2: Mix the minced onion, garlic, salt, black pepper, sugar, and spices in a bowl.
instructions.3: Season the scaloppine slices with the mixture on both sides and leave for 30 minutes.
instructions.4: Heat a tray on the stove and add the ghee and oil.
instructions.5: Add the minced garlic and sauté until golden.
instructions.6: Add the scaloppine slices and brown on both sides until golden.
instructions.7: Add the hot water, cover the tray, lower the heat, and leave for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Add the browned potato cubes and cover the tray for 2–3 minutes.
instructions.9: Serve hot with bread and parsley.

fah-019.title: Fake Beef Pane (Minced Meat Cutlets)
fah-019.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-019.culturalNotes: Freeze unfried slices between two layers of plastic for easy removal later.

instructions.1: Mince the meat and onion finely in the food processor.
instructions.2: Add the salt, pepper, seven-spice, and sugar to the minced meat and stir well.
instructions.3: Mince the meat again in the food processor to get a firm paste.
instructions.4: Prepare the coating: mix the flour, starch, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
instructions.5: Prepare the egg wash: whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and pepper in another bowl.
instructions.6: Take a portion of minced meat and shape it into slices.
instructions.7: Dip the slices in flour, then in the egg-and-milk, then in breadcrumbs.
instructions.8: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
instructions.9: Fry the slices until golden.
instructions.10: Serve the fake pane hot.

fah-020.title: Chicken Piccata with Mushrooms
fah-020.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-020.culturalNotes: Serve with white rice and sautéed vegetables for a complete meal. Leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Season the chicken slices with salt and pepper and toss well.
instructions.2: Heat the spoonful of ghee in a pan, then add the chicken slices and brown until golden.
instructions.3: Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
instructions.4: In the same pan, add the minced onion and garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.5: Add the mushrooms and stir until softened.
instructions.6: Add the demi-glace sauce mix (Knorr) and stir until dissolved.
instructions.7: Return the chicken to the pan and add about 3 cups of boiling water.
instructions.8: Let the mixture boil for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens and the chicken is cooked.
instructions.9: Add half a cup of cream and stir well.
instructions.10: Serve with white rice and sautéed vegetables.

fah-021.title: Chicken Piccata in Creamy Mushroom Sauce
fah-021.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-021.culturalNotes: Add a Kiri cube to the sauce for a nicer taste. Serve with white rice or pasta as you like.

instructions.1: Season the chicken slices well with salt, pepper, and paprika.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee and oil in a pan, then brown the chicken slices on both sides until golden.
instructions.3: Remove the chicken from the pan, leaving the browned oil in it.
instructions.4: Add the minced onion and stir until softened and golden.
instructions.5: Add the minced garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the mushrooms (fresh or canned) and stir until softened.
instructions.7: Add the flour and stir over the heat for a minute until cooked.
instructions.8: Add the boiling water (about 3 cups) and stir until smooth.
instructions.9: Add the salt and pepper and adjust the seasoning.
instructions.10: Return the chicken to the pan, cover, and leave on the heat for half an hour until cooked.
instructions.11: Add the cream (or a cup of milk with 2 tbsp ashta) and stir well.
instructions.12: Let the sauce boil once, then lower the heat and leave for a minute.
instructions.13: Serve the piccata hot with white rice or pasta, garnished with parsley leaves.

fah-022.title: Chicken Prep-Ahead Marinades for Ramadan
fah-022.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-022.culturalNotes: The marinades and chicken keep in the freezer for a month or two. Thaw before cooking — grilled chicken on a grill pan, in the oven, or in a pan; kofta on a pan or over charcoal for best results.

instructions.1: Preparing the grilled chicken marinade:
instructions.2: Mix all the following in a bowl: onion juice, orange juice, vinegar, oil, ketchup, thyme, dried coriander, salt, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, turmeric, chili, Chinese five-spice, sugar or honey, and soy sauce.
instructions.3: Mix well until combined.
instructions.4: Wash the chicken and cut it as desired.
instructions.5: Place the chicken in the marinade and toss well.
instructions.6: Store the chicken in the freezer in separate bags.
instructions.7: Preparing the paneed chicken breasts:
instructions.8: Mix the yogurt, ketchup or hot sauce, onion powder, cardamom, garlic powder, dried coriander, chicken spices, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
instructions.9: Mix well until combined.
instructions.10: Wash the chicken breasts and drain well.
instructions.11: Place the chicken breasts in the marinade and toss well.
instructions.12: In another bowl, mix the ground breadcrumbs, flour, starch, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.13: Dip the chicken pieces in the marinade, then in the breadcrumb mixture.
instructions.14: Store in the freezer in separate bags with separators between the pieces.
instructions.15: Preparing the grilled chicken kofta:
instructions.16: Mix the onion, garlic, parsley, bulgur, sugar, baking powder, salt, pepper, paprika, dried coriander, chicken spices, thyme, onion powder, and garlic powder in a bowl.
instructions.18: Shape the kofta into fingers or onto skewers.
instructions.19: Store the kofta in the freezer in separate bags with separators between the pieces.

fah-023.title: Minced Meat Prep-Ahead Mixes for Ramadan
fah-023.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-023.culturalNotes: The mixtures keep in the freezer for a long time; let them thaw half an hour before use. Hawashi goes with baladi bread or pastry, the brown kofta with basmati rice, the grilled kofta over charcoal or in the oven, and the sautéed mix in trays and casseroles.

instructions.1: Preparing the hawashi mix:
instructions.2: Wash and chop the onion, tomato, hot and sweet peppers, and parsley.
instructions.3: Mix the minced meat with the onion, tomato, hot and sweet peppers, and parsley.
instructions.4: Add the salt, pepper, seven-spice, chili, cumin, dried coriander, and flour.
instructions.5: Knead the mixture well.
instructions.6: Divide the mixture into bags and freeze.
instructions.7: Preparing the rice kofta:
instructions.8: Wash and chop the onion and parsley.
instructions.9: Boil the rice in two cups of water with salt.
instructions.10: Mix the minced meat with the onion, parsley, cooked rice, salt, pepper, seven-spice, and sugar.
instructions.11: Knead the mixture well.
instructions.12: Shape the kofta into ovals and store on a foam plate.
instructions.13: Preparing the grilled kofta:
instructions.14: Wash and mince the onion finely and squeeze out its water.
instructions.15: Mix the minced meat with the fat or tail fat, onion, washed bulgur, salt, pepper, sugar, and baking powder.
instructions.17: Shape the kofta and store on a foam plate.
instructions.20: Sauté the onion in ghee over the heat.
instructions.21: Add the minced meat, salt, pepper, cinnamon, seven-spice, and sugar.
instructions.22: Stir the mixture well until cooked.
instructions.23: Divide the mixture into bags and freeze.

fah-024.title: Chicken Stroganoff
fah-024.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-024.culturalNotes: Serve with a green salad or toasted bread. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts into small pieces like shawarma.
instructions.2: Cut the mushrooms into small slices.
instructions.3: Heat a spoonful of butter and two spoons of oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.4: Add the chicken pieces and stir with salt and pepper until golden.
instructions.5: Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
instructions.6: Add another spoonful of butter to the pot and sauté the onion until softened.
instructions.7: Add the minced garlic and stir with the onion until it takes color.
instructions.8: Add the mushrooms and stir with the onion and garlic until softened.
instructions.9: Return the chicken to the pot and add the demi-glace sauce dissolved in half a liter of cold water.
instructions.10: Stir the mixture well until it boils.
instructions.11: Add the paprika and stir.
instructions.12: Add the cream and stir until the mixture is smooth.
instructions.13: Add the boiled pasta and stir it in the sauce for 3 minutes over low heat.

fah-025.title: Chicken Roll Stuffed with Ouzi Rice
fah-025.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-025.culturalNotes: Serve the ouzi-stuffed chicken roll with a green salad or basmati rice. Keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and stir until softened.
instructions.3: Add the spices (thyme, cinnamon, black pepper) and stir briefly.
instructions.4: Add the minced meat and stir until cooked.
instructions.5: Add the peas and carrot and stir briefly.
instructions.6: Add the salt and rice and stir well.
instructions.7: Add half a cup of boiling water, cover, and lower the heat until the rice is cooked.
instructions.8: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and spices (thyme, cinnamon, onion powder).
instructions.9: Stuff the chicken with the filling and wrap it in parchment paper and aluminum foil.
instructions.10: Place the chicken in an oven tray and add about two cups of boiling water.
instructions.11: Cover the tray with foil and bake on the middle rack for an hour.
instructions.12: Once out of the oven, remove the foil and parchment and brush with ketchup.
instructions.13: Return under the broiler until it takes color.

fah-026.title: Tasbira (Boiled & Glazed Chicken)
fah-026.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-026.culturalNotes: Serve the tasbira with rice and the broth as a main meal. You can add chopped vegetables to the broth.

instructions.1: Prepare a large pot and add 2 liters of water, 3-4 squeezed lemons, 2 tablespoons of sugar, 2 tablespoons of salt, 1 tablespoon of ginger, and a cup of vinegar. Mix the ingredients well.
instructions.2: Wash the chicken well and rub it with salt and flour, then rinse it.
instructions.3: Prepare a marinade of 3 garlic cloves, one onion, one tomato, salt, and black pepper. Blend the ingredients in the food processor and rub the chicken well with it.
instructions.4: Add the chicken to the boiling water with a bay leaf, a carrot, 1-2 celery stalks, a teaspoon of sugar, salt, black pepper, two bouillon cubes, and two mastic pieces. Cover the pot and simmer the chicken gently until cooked.
instructions.5: Once the chicken is cooked, drain it well and brown it in oil and ghee with a pinch of salt.
instructions.6: Strain the broth through a sieve and serve the chicken with rice and the broth.

fah-027.title: One-Pot Rice with Potatoes and Chicken
fah-027.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-027.culturalNotes: Serve with a green salad or yogurt. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days or up to a week in the freezer.

instructions.1: Heat the butter or ghee with the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chicken pieces and sauté until golden.
instructions.3: Add the pepper and the seven-spice blend and sauté with the chicken.
instructions.4: Add the minced onion and sauté until golden.
instructions.5: Add the minced garlic and sauté with the mixture.
instructions.6: Add the tomato juice and let it reduce for a minute.
instructions.7: Add the salt, cumin, and sugar and stir the mixture well.
instructions.8: Add boiling water according to the amount of rice (one cup of water per cup of baladi rice, two cups of water per cup of basmati rice).
instructions.9: Add the potatoes and leave until half-cooked.
instructions.10: Add the washed rice and stir it well.
instructions.11: Add the two pepper pods and cover the pot.
instructions.12: Leave the rice until it absorbs the water, then stir the mixture twice.
instructions.13: Lower the heat and leave the pot until the rice is cooked.
instructions.14: Serve the pot hot.

fah-028.title: Mock Pigeon (Stuffed Chicken Thighs)
fah-028.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-028.culturalNotes: Make sure the stuffing is completely cold before stuffing the thighs. Use firm toothpicks to close them. Leftover broth works for molokhia.

fah-028-i13.name: Water
fah-028-i13.standardAmount: ¼ cup per cup of rice

instructions.1: Heat the oil and ghee in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the mastic and stir until its aroma develops.
instructions.3: Add the washed, drained rice and stir until pearly.
instructions.4: Add the cinnamon, black pepper, instant bouillon, and salt and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the finely chopped onion and stir for 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Add the garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.7: Add the honey and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the water, cover the rice, and lower the heat until half-cooked.
instructions.9: Set the rice aside to cool completely.
instructions.10: Prepare the roasting mixture of tomatoes, carrot, onion, bay leaf, ground cardamom, salt, and pepper and stir well.
instructions.11: Spread the mixture in the roasting tray.
instructions.12: Lay out the deboned thighs and season them with salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.13: Stuff the thighs with the cooled filling without overfilling them.
instructions.14: Close the thighs with toothpicks.
instructions.15: Arrange the thighs in the tray and cover with parchment paper then aluminum foil.
instructions.16: Put the tray in the oven on high heat for an hour.
instructions.17: Once done, take the tray out of the oven and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and parsley.
instructions.18: Serve the stuffed thighs with the cooked rice in a separate bowl.

fah-029.title: Baladi Hawawshi
fah-029.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-029.culturalNotes: Let the dough rise well before shaping. Add olives, tomatoes, and peppers to taste.

fah-029-i8.name: Warm water to test the yeast

instructions.1: Mix the sugar and yeast in a quarter cup of warm water and set aside for 10 minutes to proof the yeast.
instructions.2: In a bowl, mix the flour, salt, yogurt, and the quarter cup of oil.
instructions.3: Add the warm water gradually and mix until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Add the yeast mixture and mix well.
instructions.5: Knead the dough on a floured surface until smooth and cohesive.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and leave it in a warm place for an hour to rise.
instructions.7: In another bowl, mix the minced meat, fat, minced onion, tomato, hot peppers, salt, black pepper, sugar, hawawshi spices, and nutmeg.
instructions.8: Once the dough has risen, divide it into equal-sized balls.
instructions.9: Flatten each ball of dough on a floured surface and place the meat filling in the center.
instructions.10: Seal the hawawshi tightly and place them on an oiled tray.
instructions.11: Brush the hawawshi tops with a mixture of a pinch of nescafé, half a teaspoon of sugar, a tablespoon of powdered milk, and five tablespoons of water.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated 180°C oven for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.13: Serve the hawawshi hot.

fah-030.title: Charcoal-Style Chicken Hawawshi
fah-030.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-030.culturalNotes: Hawawshi keeps in the fridge for 2 days or frozen for up to a week. Serve with a green salad or roasted potatoes for a complete meal.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling: mix the minced chicken, minced onion, parsley, coriander, hot and bell peppers, tomato paste, ghee, garlic, salt, black pepper, cumin, dried coriander, paprika, sugar, and chicken spices in a bowl.
instructions.2: Mix the ingredients well until combined.
instructions.3: Prepare the bread: trim the edges of the loaf and open it gently.
instructions.4: Stuff the loaf with the filling and spread it evenly.
instructions.5: Cooking the hawawshi: heat a pan over medium heat and grease it with oil.
instructions.6: Place the hawawshi in the pan and cover for 5 minutes until golden.
instructions.7: Flip the hawawshi and cover again for 5 minutes until golden.
instructions.8: Serve the hawawshi hot with pickled lemon, nigella seeds, and safflower.

fah-031.title: Alexandrian Hawawshi
fah-031.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-031.culturalNotes: Hawawshi keeps in the fridge for 2 days or can be frozen for longer. Serve with a red sauce or white sauce as you like.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the salt, sugar, and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm water gradually and knead until the dough is smooth and cohesive.
instructions.3: Cover the dough and leave it in a warm place for 30 minutes to rise.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix the minced onion, bell pepper, hot pepper, garlic, tomato, parsley, salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, seven-spice blend, sugar, nutmeg, and instant bouillon.
instructions.5: Add the minced meat and tahini and mix well.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into equal-sized balls (the size of a large lemon).
instructions.7: Flatten each ball, place the meat filling in the center, then seal the hawawshi well.
instructions.8: Place the hawawshi on an oiled tray, cover, and leave for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush the hawawshi with egg and sprinkle with sesame.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven on high heat for 20-25 minutes until golden.
instructions.11: If frying instead, place the hawawshi in a hot oiled pan and turn until golden on all sides.
instructions.12: Serve the hawawshi hot with arugula and parsley.

fah-032.title: Chicken Drumsticks in Buffalo Sauce
fah-032.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-032.culturalNotes: Serve with browned potatoes or pasta. Leftover sauce keeps in the fridge for a long time.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken and cut it into drumsticks.
instructions.2: Score the chicken with a knife to help the flavor penetrate.
instructions.3: Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, seven-spice, and paprika.
instructions.4: Mix the flour and starch in a plastic bag.
instructions.5: Add the seasoned chicken to the bag and mix it well.
instructions.6: Heat the oil in a deep pan or pot.
instructions.7: Fry the chicken until golden.
instructions.8: Transfer to kitchen paper to absorb the excess oil.
instructions.9: In a bowl, mix the ketchup, hot sauce, vinegar, molasses, sugar, and a teaspoon of starch dissolved in a quarter cup of water.
instructions.10: Cook the mixture in a pot on the heat, stirring well, until it thickens.
instructions.11: Add the fried chicken to the sauce and mix it well.
instructions.12: Serve the chicken with the sauce and chopped parsley.

fah-033.title: Roasted Chicken Drumsticks
fah-033.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-033.culturalNotes: You can use any chicken pieces you prefer instead of drumsticks. Make sure the marinade reaches under the skin for the best taste.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken drumsticks and open them through the middle with a sharp knife.
instructions.2: Mix the smoked paprika, onion powder, instant bouillon, black pepper, garlic powder, minced garlic, ketchup, lemon juice, vinegar, white honey, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.3: Coat the drumsticks with the mixture on all sides and leave them in the fridge for two to three hours.
instructions.4: If you are short on time, place the drumsticks on a tray with a rack, skin side up and flesh side down.
instructions.5: Preheat the oven on high and put two cups of boiling water in a tray under the rack.
instructions.6: Put the tray in the oven and leave until the chicken is roasted.
instructions.7: In another pan, melt the butter over low heat, add the minced garlic, and stir until golden.
instructions.8: Add the white honey, ketchup, chopped parsley, salt, and pepper and stir well.
instructions.9: Once the chicken is roasted, spread the sauce over it.
instructions.10: Serve the drumsticks hot with spiced rice, pasta with sauce, salad, and pickles.

fah-034.title: Roast Turkey Breast
fah-034.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-034.culturalNotes: Serve the roast with rice with peas and carrots; it goes best with the sauce cooked alongside it.

instructions.1: Wash the turkey breast and leave it to dry.
instructions.2: Take a sharp knife and make slits in the turkey breast.
instructions.3: Put a little salt, a peppercorn, and a garlic clove in each slit.
instructions.4: Season the turkey breast on all sides with salt, ground pepper, and thyme.
instructions.5: Leave the turkey breast to marinate for an hour.
instructions.6: Heat a tray on the stove and add the oil and ghee.
instructions.7: Add the turkey breast and turn it until golden on all sides.
instructions.8: Remove the turkey breast and set it aside.
instructions.9: In the same tray, add the chopped vegetables (onion, carrot, tomatoes, celery, sweet pepper) and stir for a few minutes.
instructions.10: Add the bay leaves, sugar, salt, and peppercorns.
instructions.11: Pour in boiling water until it reaches halfway up the turkey breast.
instructions.12: Cover the tray and bring it to a boil, then lower the heat and leave it to cook for an hour.
instructions.13: Turn the turkey breast after a quarter of an hour and leave it to cook for another hour.
instructions.14: Remove the turkey breast, leave it to cool, then place it in the fridge.
instructions.15: Slice the turkey breast and serve it with rice with peas and carrots.

fah-035.title: Stuffed Chicken Roll
fah-035.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-035.culturalNotes: Increase the rice quantity as you like; leftover filling can be served as a side. The stuffing works with any poultry.

instructions.1: Prepare the chicken: cut the chicken open along the bone, keeping the skin, then pound it with a mallet until even.
instructions.2: Prepare the filling: wash the rice and soak it for half an hour, then drain it. Chop the onion, liver, gizzards, tomatoes, and carrot.
instructions.3: Sauté the rice: put oil in a pan and sauté the rice with the spices (cinnamon, pepper, salt, seven-spice, cardamom).
instructions.4: Add the onion: add the minced onion to the rice and stir the ingredients well.
instructions.5: Prepare the liver and gizzards: sauté the liver and gizzards in hot oil with the spices (cinnamon, pepper, seven-spice).
instructions.6: Mix the filling: mix the rice with the liver and gizzards well.
instructions.7: Stuff the chicken: stuff the chicken with the filling and tie it with string or wrap it in aluminum foil.
instructions.8: Cooking: place slices of onion, tomato, and carrot in the baking tray, then set the stuffed chicken on top. Add a cup or two of water and cover with aluminum foil.
instructions.9: Baking: place the tray in the oven on the lower rack for 15 minutes, then move it to the middle rack until cooked.
instructions.10: Prepare the remaining rice: put the leftover rice in a pan and add boiling water to half-cover it. Leave until cooked.
instructions.11: Serving: brush the chicken with ketchup and return it to the oven until browned. Slice the chicken and serve with the rice.

fah-036.title: Meat Roll Wrapped in Grape Leaves
fah-036.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-036.culturalNotes: Serve the meat roll with white rice or a green salad. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Cut the meat into wide, thin slices.
instructions.2: Season the meat with salt, pepper, ground cardamom, and seven-spice, massaging it in well.
instructions.3: Spread two spoons of tomato paste over both sides of the meat.
instructions.4: Wash a clean damp cloth and divide it into suitable pieces.
instructions.5: Place a piece of meat on the cloth and spread the grape leaves over the meat.
instructions.6: Roll it up tightly and tie it with string if you like.
instructions.7: Prepare the tagine or tray with the tomato, onion, carrot, celery, bay leaves, and rosemary.
instructions.8: Place the roll over the vegetables in the tagine.
instructions.9: Pour in water until it reaches halfway up the tagine.
instructions.10: Cover the tagine tightly with aluminum foil.
instructions.11: Preheat the oven to 200°C and place the tagine on the bottom for 30 minutes.
instructions.12: After 30 minutes, move the tagine to the middle rack and lower the temperature to 160°C.
instructions.13: Continue cooking for two to three hours until the meat and grape leaves are done.
instructions.14: When the time is up, let the roll rest briefly before serving.

fah-037.title: Mini Hawawshi Rolls
fah-037.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-037.culturalNotes: Use any spices you like in the meat mix. Serve the mini hawawshi with a white yogurt-and-tahini sauce. Keeps in the fridge for up to 2 days.

instructions.1: Preparation: cut the onion, bell pepper, and tomato into small pieces and pulse them in the food processor.
instructions.2: Preparation: add the minced meat to the vegetable mixture and mix well.
instructions.3: Preparation: add the hawawshi spices and tahini and mix the ingredients well.
instructions.4: Preparation: trim the edges of the tortilla on three sides to make it square.
instructions.5: Preparation: spread a small amount of the meat mixture on the tortilla and roll it up gently.
instructions.6: Preparation: cut the rolls into small pieces 2 cm wide and secure them with toothpicks.
instructions.7: Cooking: grease a tray with oil and place the rolls in it.
instructions.8: Cooking: brush the tops of the rolls with oil and bake in the oven on high heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Finish: prepare the tahini sauce with the yogurt, mayonnaise, mustard, black pepper, paprika, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and lemon juice.
instructions.10: Finish: mix the tahini sauce well until it has a smooth consistency.
instructions.11: Finish: serve the rolls on a serving plate with the tahini sauce and a sprinkle of nuts and pomegranate.

fah-038.title: Lamb Shank Wrapped in Grape Leaves
fah-038.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-038.culturalNotes: Cover the shank well with grape leaves and foil for a moist, delicious result. Serve with white rice or Arabic bread.

instructions.1: Mix the black pepper, salt, pinch of chili, cinnamon, saffron powder, honey, sugar, and oil in a small bowl.
instructions.2: Rub the lamb shank with the marinade on all sides.
instructions.3: Cover the shank with grape leaves on all sides.
instructions.4: Place the bay leaves, onion, and garlic in a baking tray.
instructions.5: Place a rack over them, then set the shank wrapped in grape leaves on the rack.
instructions.6: Fill the tray with water until it covers half the shank.
instructions.7: Cover the tray with parchment paper, then aluminum foil.
instructions.8: Put the tray in the oven on high heat for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Lower the temperature and leave the shank to bake for two to three hours.
instructions.10: Take the tray out of the oven and gently remove the grape leaves.
instructions.11: Serve the lamb shank hot with rice or bread.

fah-039.title: Homemade Sujuk Sausage
fah-039.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-039.culturalNotes: Serve the sujuk with bread and salads or as a main meal. Keeps in the fridge for 3 days or in the freezer for a month.

instructions.1: Clean the casing well and wash it with water, vinegar, lemon, and baking soda.
instructions.2: Chop the red bell pepper, hot pepper, onion, and garlic and mince them finely.
instructions.3: Add the bell pepper, hot pepper, onion, and garlic to the minced meat.
instructions.4: Add the salt, garlic and onion powder, black pepper, paprika, cumin, seven-spice, chili, sugar, and instant bouillon (if desired).
instructions.5: Knead the mixture well until homogeneous.
instructions.6: Fill the casing with the mixture using a funnel, distributing it evenly.
instructions.7: Tie both ends of the casing well and distribute the mixture evenly along it.
instructions.8: Cut the casing into small pieces or leave it as a roll.
instructions.9: Bake the sausage in the oven at 180°C for 30 minutes or grill it over charcoal.

fah-040.title: Smoked Chicken Sausage
fah-040.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-040.culturalNotes: The sausage keeps in the freezer in sealed bags; use it as a breakfast or a midnight snack.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken breasts, dry them, cut them, and put them in the food processor.
instructions.2: Add the red pepper, instant bouillon, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, BBQ sauce, hot sauce, starch, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
instructions.3: Process the ingredients well until smooth.
instructions.4: If you want a red color, add red food coloring.
instructions.5: Put the sausage mixture in a plastic bag greased with oil.
instructions.6: Shape the sausage into fingers and arrange them on an oiled tray.
instructions.7: Place the sausage tray over another tray of boiling water and partially cover it.
instructions.8: Leave it over the steam for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: When the time is up, remove the sausage and brush it with oil.
instructions.10: Grill the sausage in a pan on the stove until golden.
instructions.11: Serve the sausage in sandwiches with tomato, ketchup, mayonnaise, and mustard.
instructions.12: You can also slice the sausage and serve it with pasta or potatoes.

fah-041.title: Orzo Pilaf with Liver and Caramelized Onions
fah-041.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-041.culturalNotes: Garnish the dish with fried nuts and chopped parsley; serve it hot at gatherings and special occasions.

instructions.1: Heat the oil and butter in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the orzo and stir until well browned and golden.
instructions.3: Add the minced onion and stir with the orzo.
instructions.4: Add the bouillon cube, tomato paste, pepper, seven-spice, and cinnamon and stir together.
instructions.5: Add boiling water or broth so it covers the orzo.
instructions.6: Add salt to taste and leave on low heat until cooked.
instructions.7: In another pot, heat the oil and butter, add the onion, and stir until caramelized.
instructions.8: Add the liver and stir over high heat until browned.
instructions.9: Add the pepper, spices, and cinnamon and stir together.
instructions.10: Add the salt once the liver is cooked and mix it with the caramelized onion.
instructions.11: Spoon the liver and caramelized onion over the orzo.
instructions.12: Garnish the serving dish with fried nuts and parsley.

fah-042.title: Beef Filet Slices in Brown Sauce
fah-042.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-042.culturalNotes: Serve the sauce on the side so everyone can take what they like. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Season the fillet slices with salt and pepper and rub them well.
instructions.2: Dredge the fillet slices in flour.
instructions.3: Brown the fillet slices in hot ghee until golden.
instructions.4: In another pot, brown half a kilo of sliced onion.
instructions.5: Add the sugar to the onion and stir until it turns brown.
instructions.6: Add the beef bouillon cube and boiling water.
instructions.7: Let the mixture boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Add the browned fillet slices to the sauce and leave to cook for another 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Stir well until the sauce is homogeneous and dark in color.
instructions.10: Serve the slices with grilled vegetables and white rice.

fah-043.title: Smoked Chicken Breasts
fah-043.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-043.culturalNotes: The chicken breasts keep in the fridge for a long time or in the freezer for even longer. Take them out an hour before serving so they don't dry out.

instructions.1: Buy large chicken breasts, clean them, wash them, and dry them.
instructions.2: Tie the breasts with cotton string so they hold together.
instructions.3: Prepare the marinade by mixing the black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, chicken spices, smoked paprika, mustard, BBQ sauce, soy sauce, honey, hot sauce (optional), and chili (optional).
instructions.4: Dip the breasts in the marinade and rub them well.
instructions.5: Cover the breasts and refrigerate for a whole night or 3-4 hours.
instructions.6: Take the breasts out of the fridge and arrange them on a rack over a tray of boiling water.
instructions.7: Cover the breasts with parchment paper then aluminum foil.
instructions.8: Bake the breasts in the oven on high heat for 90 minutes.
instructions.9: Take the breasts out of the oven and brush them with oil for a browned color.
instructions.10: Cover the breasts again and leave them in the fridge for 3-4 hours.
instructions.11: Keep the breasts in the fridge or freezer for longer storage.

fah-044.title: Roast Turkey Breast with Saffron Rice
fah-044.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-044.culturalNotes: You can keep the turkey breasts in the fridge for a day before serving for the best result. Serve with a green salad or grilled vegetables.

instructions.1: Prepare the brine: in a bowl, mix a liter of hot water with the 4 bay leaves, 5 star anise, 2 cinnamon sticks, 10 cardamom pods, 10 cloves, 2 tbsp sugar, and 2 tbsp salt. Boil the ingredients, then add 2 liters of ice water, the 2 juiced lemons, half a cup of orange juice, and black pepper. Mix well and place the turkey breasts in the brine for 2 hours in the fridge.
instructions.2: Roast the turkey breasts in a tray over the heat with a tablespoon of butter and a tablespoon of oil. Add bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon, the onion, tomato, carrot, celery, garlic, boiling water, and salt. Cook for an hour and a quarter.
instructions.3: Prepare the saffron rice: wash the rice and drain it. In a tray, toast the rice with the ghee and oil. Add a cinnamon stick, cardamom, cloves, water, salt, and saffron. Cover the pot and leave until done.
instructions.4: Prepare the mushroom sauce: in a pan, toast a tablespoon of ghee with a tablespoon of flour until browned. Add black pepper and the drained mushrooms and stir well. Add the cooking cream and stir until thick.
instructions.5: Serve the roasted turkey breasts with the saffron rice and creamy mushroom sauce. Garnish the plate with toasted nuts and raisins.

fah-045.title: Chicken Breasts in Béchamel
fah-045.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-045.culturalNotes: Serve with salad, bread, pasta, or basmati rice. Adding mozzarella gives an extra layer of indulgence.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pan on the stove until it melts.
instructions.2: Add the diced chicken breasts and stir until browned on all sides.
instructions.3: Add the spices (pepper and chicken spices) and stir with the chicken.
instructions.4: Add the diced onion and stir with the chicken until wilted.
instructions.5: Add the grated potato and carrot and stir everything together.
instructions.6: Add the salt and stir the ingredients well.
instructions.7: In another pan, heat the ghee, add the flour, and stir until pale.
instructions.8: Add the milk gradually, stirring constantly, until the consistency is thick.
instructions.9: Add the salt, pepper, and chicken bouillon cube and stir until boiling.
instructions.10: Add the cream if desired and stir until the consistency is cohesive.
instructions.11: Put the chicken mixture in a tagine and cover it with the béchamel sauce.
instructions.12: Add the mozzarella cheese if desired.
instructions.13: Bake the tagine on medium heat until golden.
instructions.14: Serve the dish hot with salad, bread, pasta, or basmati rice.
instructions.15: The dish is ready to serve.

fah-046.title: Chicken Breasts with Corn
fah-046.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-046.culturalNotes: Serve with white rice or roasted potatoes. Cool completely and store in a sealed container in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Cut the colored peppers into medium cubes, removing the veins and seeds.
instructions.2: Cut the corn and white onions into medium cubes.
instructions.3: Place the peppers, corn, and onion in the baking tray.
instructions.4: Score the chicken breasts lengthwise and crosswise to help the marinade penetrate.
instructions.5: Prepare the marinade by mixing the salt, thyme, black pepper, chicken spices, paprika, chili, onion powder, garlic powder, honey, mustard, olive oil, and lemon juice.
instructions.6: Coat the breasts in the marinade and leave for half an hour to an hour.
instructions.7: Add the marinated breasts to the tray with the vegetables.
instructions.8: Cover the tray with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated 200°C oven for an hour.
instructions.9: Prepare the garlic sauce by mixing the garlic, salt, butter, honey, mustard, and parsley.
instructions.10: When the cooking time is up, take the breasts out of the oven and pour the sauce over them.
instructions.11: Serve them hot.

fah-047.title: Chicken Sayadiya
fah-047.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-047.culturalNotes: Garnish with fresh coriander for a distinctive flavor. Serve with a green salad or any side dish.

instructions.1: Heat the oil and ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the minced onion and sugar and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the spices (cloves, cinnamon, mastic, loomi, cardamom, bay leaves) and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the minced garlic and stir for a minute.
instructions.5: Add the salt, black pepper, ground cardamom, cumin, seven-spice, and bouillon cubes and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the chicken pieces, cover the pot, and leave on low heat for 30 minutes until cooked.
instructions.7: Add boiling water to the pot and leave on low heat for 30 minutes.
instructions.8: Remove the chicken from the pot, place it on a baking tray, brush with ketchup and honey, and put under the broiler until browned.
instructions.9: Wash the basmati rice, soak it for an hour, then drain it and add it to the pot with boiling water.
instructions.10: Leave the rice on high heat until it boils, then lower the heat and leave until cooked.
instructions.11: Garnish the dish with fresh coriander before serving.

fah-048.title: Tray of Happiness (Eid Tray)
fah-048.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-048.culturalNotes: Add layers of vegetables like peppers and tomatoes between the meat layers for a more varied flavor. The tray keeps in the fridge for 2 days or can be frozen for longer.

instructions.1: Preparing the kofta: mix the minced meat with the salt, pepper, and onion, and knead well. Shape into small balls.
instructions.2: Preparing the chops: cut the chops into pieces and make slits in them with a sharp knife.
instructions.3: Preparing the sujuk: cut the sujuk into small pieces or leave it whole as desired.
instructions.4: Preparing the marinade: mix the tomatoes, hot pepper, sweet pepper, crushed chili, crushed pepper, and ketchup together.
instructions.5: Preparing the tray: place the chops, sujuk, liver, and kidneys in the tray. Pour the marinade over them and toss well.
instructions.6: Cooking: cover the tray with aluminum foil and place it in a preheated oven on high heat for an hour.
instructions.7: Preparing the dough: mix the flour, oil, warm water, sugar, and yeast and knead well. Cover and let it rise.
instructions.8: Baking: once the meats are cooked, remove the foil and return the tray to the oven until golden.
instructions.9: Adding the dough: spread the dough and place it over the tray. Bake again until browned.
instructions.10: Serving: serve the tray hot with bread or rice.

fah-049.title: Budget Chicken & Vegetable Tray
fah-049.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-049.culturalNotes: Serve the tray with white rice or vermicelli rice. You can swap out any vegetables you don't like.

instructions.1: Cut the onions, carrots, zucchini, and potatoes into thin slices.
instructions.2: Cut the garlic into thin slices.
instructions.3: Mix the spices (cumin, coriander, black pepper, salt, sugar) with the onion, garlic, and instant bouillon.
instructions.4: Add the vegetables to the spice mixture and toss well.
instructions.5: Place the spice and vegetable mixture in the baking tray.
instructions.6: Add the washed, drained wings to the tray and toss well.
instructions.7: Cut the tomatoes and peppers and scatter them over the top of the tray.
instructions.8: Add the tomato sauce and boiling water and toss well.
instructions.9: Cover the tray with aluminum foil and add two tablespoons of oil.
instructions.10: Place the tray in a preheated oven on high heat and leave for an hour.
instructions.11: Remove the cover after an hour and leave for another 10 minutes until browned.

fah-050.title: Liver Tray with Tail Fat
fah-050.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-050.culturalNotes: You can swap the tail fat for butter cubes or two tablespoons of ghee for a rich taste. Serve the tray with bread or rice.

instructions.1: Cut the meat and liver into small cubes.
instructions.2: Cut the tail fat into thin slices.
instructions.3: Cut the tomatoes, hot pepper, and bell pepper into medium cubes.
instructions.4: Add the chopped onions and garlic to the tray.
instructions.5: Add the black pepper, cinnamon, seven-spice, and salt.
instructions.6: Add the hot ketchup, mustard, and honey and toss the ingredients well.
instructions.7: Cover the tray with parchment paper, then aluminum foil.
instructions.8: Place the tray in a very hot oven for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Lower the heat and leave it for 45 minutes.
instructions.10: Take the tray out of the oven, add the ghee or butter, and cover it quickly.
instructions.11: Return the tray to the oven for 10 more minutes to finish.

fah-051.title: Baked Kofta Tray
fah-051.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-051.culturalNotes: You can smoke the kofta after it comes out of the oven for a charcoal flavor. Serve with shami bread, sumac onions, and parsley for a complete dish.

instructions.1: Make the vegetable mixture: place the onion, tomato, hot pepper, and red pepper in the food processor and blend well.
instructions.2: Make the kofta mixture: add the minced meat to the vegetable mixture, then add the breadcrumbs, black pepper, paprika, salt, sugar, meat spices, and baking powder. Knead well until the mixture holds together.
instructions.3: Shape the kofta: form the kofta into fingers and make ridges on the surface to mimic a grilled look.
instructions.4: Arrange the kofta in an oiled tray.
instructions.5: Add the hot pepper if you like for a nice aroma.
instructions.6: Place the tray in the oven preheated to the highest temperature until cooked through.
instructions.7: Make the sauce: in a pan, add the paprika and tomato paste, then mix well.
instructions.8: Make the onion mixture: cut the onions into wedges, add the salt and sumac, and toss well. Add the chopped parsley.
instructions.9: Prepare the bread: brush the shami bread with the onion mixture, then place the grilled kofta on top.
instructions.10: Serve the dish hot.

fah-052.title: Minced Meat & Potato Tray
fah-052.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-052.culturalNotes: Serve with vermicelli rice, salad, and pickles. Leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Blend the onion, garlic, parsley, pepper, and tomatoes in the food processor until smooth.
instructions.2: Cut the potatoes into thin slices.
instructions.3: Arrange the potato slices in the baking tray.
instructions.4: Add the minced meat and ground tail fat to the smooth vegetable mixture.
instructions.5: Add the black pepper, sugar, baking powder, salt, and instant bouillon to the meat and knead well.
instructions.6: Spread the meat mixture over the potato slices in the tray.
instructions.7: Place the tray in a preheated oven on high heat (about 200°C) on the middle rack.
instructions.8: Bake for 30 minutes until the meat and potatoes are cooked.

fah-053.title: Potato & Chicken Tray with Béchamel
fah-053.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-053.culturalNotes: Add a pinch of thyme and cinnamon for a distinctive taste. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days or can be frozen for longer.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into thin slices.
instructions.2: Cut the chicken breasts into thin slices.
instructions.3: Cut the onions into wedges.
instructions.4: Heat the butter in a pan and brown the chicken until golden, then set aside.
instructions.5: In the same pan, add the onion and stir until golden.
instructions.6: Add the sugar, salt, and pepper, and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the flour and stir until it turns pale.
instructions.8: Add the cold milk and stir well until the sauce is smooth.
instructions.9: Add the salt and pepper and stir well.
instructions.10: In the baking tray, place a layer of potatoes, then a layer of chicken, then another layer of potatoes.
instructions.11: Pour the béchamel over the layers.
instructions.12: Cover the tray and place it in a preheated oven at 200°C for 30–45 minutes.
instructions.13: Once the potatoes are cooked, take the tray out and place the cheese on top.
instructions.14: Return the tray to the oven until the cheese is golden.
instructions.15: Serve hot.

fah-054.title: Potato & Meat Tray
fah-054.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-054.culturalNotes: Serve the tray with salad and white rice for a complete meal. You can also add a small piece of tail fat to the meat for a distinctive taste.

instructions.1: Preparing the spices and minced onion: mix the salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, paprika, ground cardamom, and seven-spice with the finely minced onion. Rub the onion well to release the aroma of the spices.
instructions.2: Preparing the tray: place the two sliced onions in the bottom of the tray. Arrange half of the browned potatoes over the onion.
instructions.3: Adding the meat: place half of the seasoned minced onion over the potatoes. Add the halved garlic head. Spread the meat over the onion and potatoes.
instructions.4: Finishing the layers: place the rest of the seasoned minced onion over the meat. Spread the tomato slices and remaining browned potatoes over the top.
instructions.5: Covering the tray: cover the tray with parchment paper, then aluminum foil. Press the edges well for a good seal.
instructions.6: Baking the tray: place the tray in a 200°C oven for 15 minutes. Then lower the temperature to 160°C and leave for 2 hours.
instructions.7: Browning: when the time is up, remove the cover and place the tray under the broiler for 5 minutes to take a light color.
instructions.8: Serving: sprinkle paprika over the top and serve hot with salad and white rice.

fah-055.title: Chicken & Potato Gratin Tray
fah-055.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-055.culturalNotes: You can skip the cheese to make the dish more economical. Serve with vermicelli rice and salad for a complete meal.

instructions.1: Peel and wash the potatoes, then cut them into thin slices.
instructions.2: Cut the onion into thin slices.
instructions.3: Season the potatoes and onion with the salt, black pepper, paprika, seven-spice, and stock, then mix well.
instructions.4: Cut the chicken into thin pieces, then toss with the salt and pepper.
instructions.5: Heat a pan on the stove, add the butter cube, and brown the chicken until it takes color.
instructions.6: Place the potato and onion mixture in the baking tray, then add the chicken on top.
instructions.7: Toss the mixture well so everything combines.
instructions.8: Blend the flour and milk together in the blender.
instructions.9: Pour the mixture over the potatoes and chicken in the tray.
instructions.10: Cover the potatoes with the milk, then place the tray in the oven on the middle rack at 200°C until the potatoes are cooked.
instructions.11: Add the cheese on top, then return the tray to the oven until the cheese melts and turns golden.
instructions.12: Serve hot with vermicelli rice and salad.

fah-056.title: Meat, Vegetable & Rice Tray
fah-056.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-056.culturalNotes: Use white basmati rice for the best results. You can also add Aleppo pistachios when serving for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Cut the meat into small pieces.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee and oil in a pot over the heat, then add the cardamom, mastic, and bay leaf.
instructions.3: Add the meat and toss until it changes color.
instructions.4: Lower the heat, cover the pot, and let the meat cook for 10 minutes until half-done.
instructions.5: Add the chopped onion and toss until golden.
instructions.6: Add the carrots and peas and toss the ingredients together.
instructions.7: Add the bouillon cube, salt, pepper, and seven-spice, then cover the pot and let it cook for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: In another pot, boil the rice in boiling water with the cardamom, loomi, cinnamon, cloves, salt, and oil for 8 minutes until half-cooked.
instructions.9: Drain the rice and add it to the pot with the vegetables and meat.
instructions.10: Add the water and saffron, stir the ingredients well, then cover the pot and let it cook over low heat for 10 minutes.
